title: NVIDIA Introduces Hardware-Aware LLM Compression (24 minute read)

title: What objective is reasoning solving? (12 minute read)
summary: Reasoning is pathfinding in token space. There are many paths from the problem to a correct answer, and the model traverses each of them with each sample. A path is not guaranteed to converge to the correct answer - it's only in aggregate, over the distribution of paths, do we get a high probability of success. RL training directly raises the success probability. The gains credited to 'thinking longer' come from the search paid for during training rather than at inference.
ai_summary: 추론은 토큰 공간에서의 경로 탐색이며, 모델은 문제에서 정답까지 다양한 경로를 탐색합니다. RL 훈련은 성공 확률을 직접 높이며, '오래 생각하기'의 이점은 훈련 중의 검색에서 비롯됩니다.

title: Two Kinds of Test-Time Scaling (28 minute read)
summary: Test-time scaling trades compute for performance at test time.
